data.body: AC amendment (gap G8): schema_drift_signal routing — pin dedup_key namespace alignment. Both probe-emitted alerts (sibling story 60c3) and repair_property follow_on-emitted alerts use the SAME dedup_key namespace: `bridge-alert:schema-drift:<issue_key>`. This guarantees alert_store.is_deduped catches the second filing regardless of which path emitted first. Add an explicit RED test: stage a fixture where both probe and repair_property fail for the same DIG-X same pass → assert exactly ONE bug ticket is filed (dedup caught the duplicate).
